title: Benefits & Perks Update (2025)
author: Monica Patel
content:
# Overview
This page summarizes **changes to employee benefits and perks** that take effect in 2025. It is intended to be a single reference that People Ops can link to from Slack announcements and email updates.

# What changed (effective dates)
## 1) Wellness stipend (effective 2025-02-01)
- **Increase:** $750/year → **$1,200/year**
- Eligible expenses: fitness memberships, classes, mindfulness apps, ergonomic accessories, and other health-related reimbursements
- Reimbursement cadence: monthly (up to the annual cap)

## 2) Mental health benefit (effective 2025-02-01)
- New benefit: **8 therapy/coaching sessions per year** through our EAP partner
- Sessions are confidential; People Ops only receives aggregated usage reporting

## 3) Parental leave update (effective 2025-03-01)
- **Primary caregiver leave:** 12 weeks → **16 weeks**
- **Secondary caregiver leave:** 6 weeks → **8 weeks**
- Applies to birth, adoption, and foster placement

# What did NOT change
- Medical/dental/vision coverage remains with the current carriers for 2025.
- 401(k) match policy is unchanged.

# How to use / where this was announced
- Slack: #announcements (People Ops)
- Email: "2025 Benefits & Perks refresh" to all employees
- All-hands: February 2025 segment

# FAQ
**Q: Do I need to do anything to get the increased wellness stipend?**
A: No enrollment action is required. Submit reimbursements in the benefits portal as usual; the cap will update automatically.

**Q: Who is eligible for parental leave changes?**
A: All full-time employees. If you are currently on leave or planning leave around the effective date, contact People Ops for a case-by-case review.
